name: 28390 · Spring Lake, NC
findings: ZIP 28390 (Spring Lake) has 62 nonprofit organizations. 19 of them (31%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28390 (Spring Lake) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28390 (Spring Lake) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 62% of the typical level).
